title: A flexible, stable, semi-dry electrode with low impedance for electroencephalography recording
content:
RSC Adv., 2024, 14,34415-34427
DOI: 10.1039/D4RA05560H, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution-NonCommercial 3.0 Unported Licence.
Yiyan Zhu, Caicaike Bayin, Hongjie Li, Xiaokang Shu, Jiangnan Deng, Haowen Yuan, Huyan Shen, Zhou Liang, Yao Li
A low-impedance, stable, and flexible RGOPU semi-dry electrode is fabricated for EEG recording in BCI systems by self-assembly reduction. It achieves a low skin-contact impedance (<5.6 kΩ) and high quality in EEG recordings for a high BCI accuracy.
